objectives.title: Vision, mission & objectives
objectives.summary: Advancing education and research through networks, applications and institutional ICT capabilities.

sections.title: Vision
sections.body: Develop and deliver high-quality networks, applications and services that advance research and education in India.

sections.title: Mission
sections.body: Provide network infrastructure and connectivity suited to education and research; pursue networking and application research; and develop skilled people in networking.

sections.title: National academic networking
sections.body: Operate a national education and research network and provide reliable, capable and contemporary network services to its institutional users.

sections.title: Research and capacity
sections.body: Undertake research in data communication and applications, develop networking human resources, and provide ICT project implementation and consultancy for the target community.

organization.title: Organization & governance
organization.summary: ERNET’s published structure connects institutional governance with technical, administrative and financial functions.

sections.title: Governing Council
sections.body: The organization chart identifies the Union Minister for Electronics and IT as chair of the Governing Council and the Minister of State as vice-chair. The published council includes ministry and institutional representation. Membership can change; consult the official roster.

sections.title: Executive and financial structure
sections.body: The Executive Committee is chaired by the Secretary for Electronics and IT. The chart also identifies a Finance and Accounts Committee, Director General and Group Coordinator.

sections.title: Functional areas
sections.body: The organization chart lists Research & Development, Registrar, Finance, NCD, Emerging Technologies, and ICT & Capacity Building. It does not provide a complete current duty statement for every division.

sections.title: Decision-making responsibilities
sections.body: The RTI disclosure describes administrative examination through personnel/general administration and the Registrar, followed by approval by the competent authority. Technical matters pass through the relevant technical officers and divisional heads to the competent authority. Higher-level matters follow the delegated approval structure.

sections.title: Rules and delegated powers
sections.body: The published RTI page says the society operates under its bylaws and uses applicable central-government rules where approved society rules do not exist. Detailed powers are provided in the delegation document; no additional governing powers are inferred here.

citizen-charter.title: Citizen’s Charter
citizen-charter.summary: The published charter describes the institution’s service purpose and feedback expectations.

sections.title: Institutional services
sections.body: The charter covers connectivity alongside consultancy, project management, training, hosting, email, video conferencing and domain registration for education and research organizations.

sections.title: Vision and service commitment
sections.body: Its stated approach emphasizes innovation, responsiveness, capable staff, useful services and continual improvement for the institutional community.

sections.title: Feedback and grievance handling
sections.body: The charter describes helpdesk and feedback channels for receiving suggestions and complaints, review of issues and communication of actions by email. Use the currently published service helpdesk contacts for a specific request.

sections.title: Role of users
sections.body: The charter asks clients to provide feedback about service performance and constructive suggestions for improvements.

sections.title: Reading historical technical details
sections.body: The charter includes legacy connectivity speeds and older counter hours. These are retained in the source document; this summary does not treat them as current service availability or a current support schedule.

acts-rules.title: Acts, rules & governance documents
acts-rules.summary: Published institutional rules and linked public-information records.

sections.title: Official directory
sections.body: The Acts and Rules page links to the Right to Information section. That section supplies the institution’s document index and governance references.

sections.title: Published document set
sections.body: The RTI index links delegated powers, rules and regulations, bylaws, the Memorandum of Association, and recruitment rules/promotion policy.

sections.title: Dates and versions
sections.body: The RTI index labels delegation of powers effective 4 January 2017 and the other listed instruments effective 1 April 2005. These are the dates shown in that index, not a finding that no amendments exist. Read the official documents and confirm current applicability where required.

rti.title: Right to Information
rti.summary: Official public-information resources and the designated institutional contact role.

sections.title: Information available
sections.body: The official RTI page covers organizational functions, officer duties, decision-making channels, norms, rules, committees, staff directory, remuneration and public-information facilities.

sections.title: Public Information Officer
sections.body: The page designates the Registrar and Chief Personnel Officer as Public Information Officer and also lists this role for public/staff grievances. Published contact: registrar@eis.ernet.in; +91 11-22170598; ERNET headquarters, DMRC IT Park, Shastri Park, New Delhi 110053.

sections.title: Applications and appeals
sections.body: Use the official RTI page to confirm the current officer and appellate authority. The main website links to the Government of India RTI Online portal. This replica does not accept or submit statutory applications.

sections.title: Annual information
sections.body: Annual reports, decision-making disclosures and governance documents are linked from the official information framework.

disclosures.title: Proactive disclosures
disclosures.summary: The official disclosure index organizes institutional public information into six groups.

sections.title: Organization and functions
sections.body: The index covers duties, powers, decision-making, work norms, rules and records, committees, directory, remuneration, information officers, disciplinary matters and transfer policy.

sections.title: Budget and programmes
sections.body: It lists budget allocation, expenditure/disbursement information, travel, subsidies, grants, concessions and audit-related material.

sections.title: Public interface
sections.body: The index covers public consultation arrangements, communication of decisions, accessible dissemination and availability of information manuals.

sections.title: Electronic information and RTI reporting
sections.body: Listed topics include available electronic information, citizen facilities, RTI applications and appeals, and parliamentary responses.

sections.title: Additional and voluntary disclosure
sections.body: The remaining groups cover other prescribed information and material disclosed proactively. The index includes headings whose underlying details may require following the official document links; their presence is not proof that every entry has a complete public attachment.

research.title: Research & development
research.summary: Published networking research and documented experimental projects.

sections.title: Research scope
sections.body: The official research page describes high-speed networking, network management, wireless sensor networks, future Internet research, mobility in IP networks and cloud computing. These are research subjects, not a commercial cloud product catalogue.

sections.title: Optical wireless communication
sections.body: The documented LiFi pilot with IIT Madras covers 2017–2019. A MeitY-funded project with IIIT Delhi describes optical wireless access for rural and urban scenarios during 2019–2022, including hybrid LiFi/Wi-Fi experiments and last-mile communication designs.

sections.title: IoT innovation
sections.body: The published Centre of Excellence initiative involves MeitY, NASSCOM and ERNET and describes startup support, interoperable laboratories, testing and applications across domains such as health, manufacturing and agriculture.

sections.title: IPv6 and technical resources
sections.body: The completed-project directory links Mobile IPv6, 6LoWPAN and VSESS research displays. Their historical publication does not establish a current product release or live demonstration service.

events.title: Events & workshops archive
events.summary: Verified historical meetings and capacity-building events from ERNET’s published archive.

sections.title: 43rd APAN Meeting · 12–17 February 2017
sections.body: The archive records the meeting at India Habitat Centre, New Delhi, focused on the Asia-Pacific research and education networking community.

sections.title: 6LoWApp workshop · 20 October 2012
sections.body: A one-day workshop on building IPv6-enabled wireless sensor network applications at IISc Bengaluru, organized by the ECE Department and ERNET’s Bengaluru Regional Centre. The audience included engineering faculty, scientists and researchers.

sections.title: 32nd APAN Meeting · 22–27 August 2011
sections.body: The archive lists the meeting at The Lalit, New Delhi, in support of advanced networking and research collaboration.

sections.title: ELITEX · 5 April 2011
sections.body: The Department of Information Technology event at India Habitat Centre, New Delhi, presented research and technology developments to users and industry.

sections.title: US–India Network Enabled Research Collaboration Workshop · 5–7 December 2010
sections.body: Hosted in New Delhi, the workshop brought networking experts and domain researchers together to examine infrastructure and collaboration opportunities.

sections.title: E-infrastructure and distance learning symposium · 28–29 January 2009
sections.body: The archive describes a BELIEF/6CHOICE symposium at India Habitat Centre on distance learning, innovation and e-infrastructure.

sections.title: Archive status
sections.body: These are historical events. No current registration, available seats or new schedule is implied.
